acme_challenge_hint: Serve the tokens published by the acme adapter under /.well-known/acme-challenge/, so the acme adapter does not have to stop this instance to get port 80.
basic_authentication_info: You can enable basic authentication for the web server. It will be enabled additionally to OAuth2 and custom token authentications.
color: Background color of the login screen
cookie_same_site_none: Allow embedding in other sites (SameSite=None cookies)
cookie_same_site_none_https_warning: Embedding without HTTPS: browsers accept "SameSite=None" only together with "Secure". The setting is ignored. Enable encryption, or put this server behind an https reverse proxy and set the public URL.
cookie_same_site_none_info:
Sends the session cookie with "SameSite=None; Secure", so a page of this server keeps its session when another site embeds it in an iframe.
This gives up the protection "SameSite" provides against requests of foreign pages, so switch it on only if you really embed this server somewhere.
It needs encryption here or an https reverse proxy in front, and it works only in browsers that still accept third-party cookies. Passing the OAuth2 token in the URL ("?token=...") works without cookies.
disable_files: Do not serve web files from ioBroker storage
forceWebSockets_info: Socket.io supports different communication ways: web socket and long-polling. By activating of this flag, you can force socket.io to communicate only via web sockets.
http2_hint: Browsers load the pages over a single connection with many parallel requests. Clients without HTTP/2 automatically fall back to HTTP/1.1
incorrect_ip: The provided IP is not valid
legacy_authentication_info: Web server supports OAuth2 authentication and authentication with custom token in cookie.\nHere you can say that login page should authenticate with custom cookie (legacy) and not via OAuth2.\nThat could be required for third party adapters.
modal_title: The password will be sent via unsecure connection. To protect your passwords enable the secure connection (HTTPS)!
oauth_authorization_code: Allow third-party clients (OAuth authorization code flow)
oauth_authorization_code_info:
Lets external clients such as MCP clients be authorized through a browser login and consent page, so they never see the ioBroker password.
They discover the server on their own and, unless self-registration is switched off, register themselves.
oauth_https_warning: OAuth without HTTPS: remote clients refuse plain http:// and will not be able to connect. Enable encryption, or put this server behind an https reverse proxy and set the public URL.
oidc_callback_dynamic: Use the external URL of this Web instance followed by /sso-callback. Set Public URL if it differs from the URL derived from the request.
oidc_callback_info: Register this redirect URI at your identity provider:
oidc_https_warning: For remote OIDC sign-in, use HTTPS. Enable encryption or set an HTTPS Public URL for the reverse proxy.
oidc_user_list_conflict: Single sign-on cannot be used together with the user access list: "access web interface as" would put another user into the login, which is valid in admin too. Single sign-on stays off while the user access list is enabled.
renew_certificates: Use this instance for automatic update
rootPath_hint: Public URL path prefix when web is served behind a reverse proxy (e.g. /web/). Used for WebSocket connections. Leave empty if web is accessed at the domain root.
set_certificates: Set certificates or load it first in the system settings (right top).
socket: Socket.IO Instance (Optional): (Used by adapters like rickshaw or vis)
usePureWebSockets_info: You can select here if socket.io library or native web-sockets will be used for communication. We suggest to activate this flag.
use_lets: Use Lets Encrypt staging (for testing/debug. Only for developer)
visu_qr_error_ssl: The ioBroker.visu app cannot authenticate on a secure web server. Switch off either authentication or SSL.
visu_qr_hide: Click to hide the QR code
visu_qr_no_cloud: No cloud or iot instance found. The code carries the local connection only, so the app reaches this server in the local network but not from outside.
visu_qr_save_first: Please save the settings first: the app connects with the saved configuration.
visu_qr_scan: Scan this code from the "ioBroker visu" app (version 2.0.0 and up)
visu_qr_show: Show QR code for the ioBroker.visu app
warning_incorrectly: Warning: Incorrectly disabling functions use can cause unexpected behaviour.
whitelist_only_with_integrated_socket: White list works only with integrated socket-io interface
ext_wt_enabled_hint: Pages use WebTransport when the browser and the network allow it (UDP), otherwise WebSocket as before.
ext_wt_tls_insecure_warning: Without a check anybody in the network can pretend to be this server. Use it only in a laboratory.
ext_wt_port_hint: 0 = the same number as the web port
ext_wt_rpc_streams: Requests a page may run at once
ext_list_hint: Adapters that run inside this web server. They are not cards of the start page; here you choose how each one reaches the browser and in which stream each of its channels travels.
ext_none: No adapter runs as a web extension of this instance.
ext_legacy_hint: speaks HTTP/WebSocket: carried whole in a stream of its own
ext_lane_normal_hint: Ordered, together with the other normal values of the page
ext_lane_alarm_hint: Highest priority, every change in order, never merged
ext_lane_bulk_hint: Large data (tables, files, history), lowest priority
ext_lane_telemetry_hint: Fast values, the latest wins, a lost one is not repeated. Never for alarms or commands.
ext_lane_isolated_hint: A stream only for this channel: if it is slow, it holds up nothing else
ext_lane_rpc_hint: Every request in a short stream of its own
ext_lane_tunnel_hint: The extension's HTTP/WebSocket traffic in a stream of its own
